levels.name: Beginner
levels.description: The base of English sentences: be, present simple, articles, there is/are, present continuous, can, past simple…

levels.name: Elementary
levels.description: Past continuous, present perfect, comparatives, future forms, modals, conditionals…

lessons.title: The verb “to be”: am, is, are
lessons.goal: Say who you are, what you do and how you feel.

lessons.title: Present simple: I work, she works
lessons.goal: Talk about routines — and remember the -s with he/she/it.

lessons.title: Present simple: don't / doesn't, Do…? / Does…?
lessons.goal: Make negatives and ask questions about habits.

lessons.title: Articles: a, an, the (and no article)
lessons.goal: Choose a / an / the — or nothing — correctly.

lessons.title: There is / There are
lessons.goal: Say what exists in a place.

lessons.title: Present continuous: I am working now
lessons.goal: Talk about actions happening now: am/is/are + -ing.
